subject: general
question:
Six numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the given figure. Find the number on the face opposite to the number 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9608bc5099a8928497941117f1df9207bbc3730de9b6dfe40875691227bf8256.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 5 is common on both the dice I and III, it is clear that 2, 1, 4, and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e., 3 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82c27a89bb11ce5f8de1056a663371262b82e08da8d6dc2c32ccfe29882ea863.png] 

Opposite pairs:

1 → 6

2 → 4

3 → 5

So, the opposite side of "4" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "4".
